governance_object: Information about governance actors: conformity-assessment bodies and their identifying symbols (governance-system object)
mechanism: Information (notification); Authorization (designation) appears only as an antecedent in a relative clause
instrument: Notification of designated bodies to the Commission (notification family; no register is constituted by this statement)
direct_text_elements: Actor Member States; action notify; recipient Commission; object bodies and identifying symbols; qualifiers: established in the Community, designated for certification, product checks and associated surveillance tasks pertaining to Article 9 procedures
inferred_elements: None. Article 9 was read only to understand 'procedures referred to in Article 9'; no element was added.
authority_note: Duty on Member States; the Commission is recipient with no stated power. Designation (antecedent) is the source of the bodies' task capacity; effect of the bodies' acts not stated.
discretion_note: Not coded (mandatory formulation, no choice indicators).
accountability_note: Information component only; no forum assessment, justification or consequence stated.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P03-01 (information) and R-P03-02 (designation, thin). Rejected: R-P03-08 and R-P03-09 (receipt and designation do not state oversight).

governance_object: Information about governance actors: test laboratories designated for Article 9 procedures
instrument: Information to the Commission on designated test laboratories (notification family)
direct_text_elements: Actor Member States; action inform; recipient Commission; object test laboratories; qualifiers: established in the Community, designated for tests pertaining to Article 9 procedures
inferred_elements: None. The second sentence of Article 10(2) (notified bodies applying criteria for laboratory designation) is outside the excerpt and was not coded.
authority_note: Duty on Member States; Commission has no stated power. Designation (antecedent) is the source of the laboratories' task capacity.
discretion_note: Not coded (mandatory formulation, no choice indicators).
accountability_note: Information component only; not accountability.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P03-01 (merged with CS-P03-001, same typed dyad and instrument) and R-P03-03 (designation of laboratories, thin). Rejected: R-P03-08.

governance_object: Organizations / processes: the manufacturer's quality system (owner resolved from Annex III points 3.1 and 3.2)
function: Verification / assurance (assessment of conformity of a quality system)
instrument: Quality-system assessment (verification / assurance family)
direct_text_elements: Actor notified body; action assess; object quality system; purpose: to determine whether it satisfies the requirements referred to in point 3.2
inferred_elements: Owner of the quality system (manufacturer) taken from the quoted cross-reference to point 3.2 and from point 3.1 ('his quality system'). Identity of 'notified body' with the bodies of Article 10(1) rests on Annex III point 6 and is used only at configuration level.
authority_note: Capacity to assess conformity with point 3.2; the legal consequence of the assessment is not in the frozen statements and is not coded.
discretion_note: Not coded; assessment judgment cannot be determined from the statement and none is inferred from the role.
accountability_note: None constituted: no duty of the body to inform, justify or answer to a forum in this statement.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P03-04 (verification) with the second party fixed by a quoted cross-reference. Deferred: R-P03-11 (approval effect not stated in the frozen statements).

governance_object: Information: the assessment decision and its stated contents (conclusions of the examination and the reasoned decision)
function: Information provision (notification of a decision with reasons)
instrument: Notification of the assessment decision to the manufacturer (information family)
direct_text_elements: Action notify; recipient manufacturer; object the decision; content: conclusions of the examination and the reasoned assessment decision
inferred_elements: None. No actor was supplied; the neighbouring sentences mention the notified body and an 'auditing team' but the text does not say who notifies.
authority_note: Not coded (duty-bearer unexpressed).
discretion_note: Not coded.
accountability_note: Textual components present: information and reasons owed to the manufacturer. No forum assessment or consequence stated; no accountability relation constituted.
decision_reason: Relation deferred: the actor is unexpressed, so any relation would rest on an inferred actor. The statement is retained as an assignment with an identified recipient.

governance_object: Organizations / processes: the manufacturer's maintenance and application of the quality system
function: Monitoring and verification (periodic audit under surveillance)
instrument: Audit (verification / assurance family)
direct_text_elements: Actor notified body; action carry out audits; object manufacturer's maintenance and application of the quality system; conditions: at reasonable intervals; purpose to make sure the manufacturer maintains and applies the system
inferred_elements: None. The manufacturer is expressed in the statement text.

discretion_note: Indicator present: 'reasonable intervals' (open-textured); range, reviewability and justification not stated; degree not graded.
accountability_note: None constituted in the statement.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P03-05. Rejected: R-P03-10 (audit report to the auditee is not accountability of the notified body).

governance_object: Information: the audit report

inferred_elements: None.

accountability_note: Information to the audited party only; the recipient is not stated to be a forum with power to assess or sanction the notified body.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P03-06. Rejected: R-P03-10.

actor_coded: Independent audit (grammatical subject); auditor role from CS-P04-002
governance_object: Not stated in the statement: only the timing is given (end of the phased registration). The audited object appears in a sentence outside the frozen statements and is not coded.
function: Verification / assurance and information provision (independent audit; reporting of findings)
instrument: Independent audit (verification / assurance family)
modality: shall (audit shall be performed; shall report)
direct_text_elements: Grammatical subject 'independent audit'; action report; object findings; recipient Commission; conditions: at the end of the phased registration; audit performed at the expense of the Registry
inferred_elements: The reporting party is read as the auditor of CS-P04-002 (same paragraph); no natural-person actor inserted.
authority_note: Duty to report findings; no stated power of the Commission over the findings.
discretion_note: Not coded (scope of the audit not stated).
accountability_note: Information component only (to the Commission); forum assessment and consequence not stated; accountability of any audited party not established.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P04-01 (reporting). R-P04-02 (appointment) is primarily supported by CS-P04-002; this statement contributes the Registry-expense condition. Deferred: R-P04-04 (funding) and R-P04-05 (audit of an unstated party).

governance_object: Governance systems: the auditor (an actor that performs governance)
mechanism: Authorization (appointment); Participation (consultation of the Commission as a precondition)
instrument: Appointment of the auditor (authorization family: designation)

inferred_elements: None.

discretion_note: Registry's choice conditioned on consultation; no criteria stated; not graded.
accountability_note: None between auditor and Registry in this statement.
decision_reason: Accepted: R-P04-02 (appointment) and R-P04-03 (consultation, thin); this statement also fixes the auditor role used as party of R-P04-01. Deferred: R-P04-05 (audited party not in the frozen statements).
